consequences.text: In 2021 a US federal court approved Unity's settlement of a class action, with no finding of wrongdoing. For three years Unity had to keep a COPPA flag for developers, offer a contextual-ads-only setting and switch it on for apps in Google Play's Designed for Families program, delete advertising IDs it held from listed children's apps, and let users opt out of interest-based ads.
consequences.wording: Settled with a US federal court's approval on 2021-04-12, with no finding of wrongdoing.
